name: Seismic Attribute Analysis (탄성파 속성 분석)
description: OpendTect에서 탄성파 속성을 계산하고 시각화하는 워크플로우. 매뉴얼 §1.5.1a Bright Spot (on-the-fly Energy attribute) 및 배치 경로 양쪽을 커버.

signature_audit.reason: unified3 signature refinement (over-absorption fix). Original signature had generic keywords like 'Analysis', 'Attributes', 'Attribute Set 3D' that leaked into steps 0-3 (where the Attribute Set 3D window is already open). Narrowed to pre-open state markers only: 'menu (unclicked)', 'toolbar icon (unclicked)', 'no attribute dialog open'. No scenario step captures this pre-open state, so this node should route rarely — that is intended.

attribute list <All> empty — no attribute added yet

signature_audit.reason: v3 iteration 3 (2026-09-18, user directive): the real Attribute Set 3D dialog shows OpendTect defaults the moment it opens (attribute type Similarity, Time gate -28/28, Input Data set), so the 2026-08-07 signature of node 02 ('empty attribute set, parameter panel disabled') never matched the freshly-opened screen and node 04 ('Time gate populated') matched it instead (iteration 0 misroutes s0/s1 -> 04; iteration-1 offline reconstruction flipped 02/03 -> 04). The three nodes are now distinguished by observable field states: 02 = type Similarity (default) + empty attribute list + Attribute Name empty; 03 = type Energy + Attribute Name empty + empty list; 04 = Attribute Name filled 'Energy [-28,+28]' / Energy entry in the list / Save on Close / 'Save Attribute as' dialog. 'freshly opened' + 'empty attribute set' + 'about to choose an Attribute Type' are step_0-unique phrases; steps 1-4 have Type already selected and parameters filled in, so these keywords will not leak.

nodes.title: Inline 우클릭 → Add > Attribute → Select dialog → Energy 렌더 (on-the-fly)
nodes.description: 매뉴얼 §1.5.1a steps 6-9 통합: (a) Tree scene 에 In-line default data 추가 및 inline 번호 250 변경 후 표시된 inline 을 우클릭, (b) Add > Attribute submenu 선택으로 Select dialog 오픈 (label 'Select Layer 2'), Attributes radio (on-the-fly) 선택 시 'Energy [-28,+28]' 표시, (c) OK 로 렌더링 확정 → In-line 250 에 Energy 속성 색상 매핑 오버레이 (color bar 표시, bright-spot 하이라이트). 이 세 스텝 (5, 6, 7) 을 담당.

screenshot_keywords: no attribute overlay on the inline yet

signature_audit.reason: unified3 signature refinement — CRITICAL absent-node fix, second iteration. First iteration used generic phrases and was outcompeted by d3_visualization_02_add_inline (step 5) and fault_interpretation_02_display (step 7). Diagnosis via top-k probe: my node ranked 6th/8th, not in top-3 for LLM rerank. Second iteration replaces generic keywords with dense step-5/6/7-unique quoted phrases: 'on-the-fly energy overlay', 'no attribute overlay on the inline yet', 'prepares the display target', '\'Select Layer 2\'', '\'Energy [-28,+28]\'', 'energy attribute color mapping', 'bright-spot highlights', 'color bar visible (energy palette)', 'In-line > 250 branch expanded'. Reduced UI elements to 2 and dialog to a broad-matching '3D Scene' (matches all three target steps' vs_text via 'in-line slice at inline position 250' or '3d scene rendered' substrings). Result: expected top-3 for steps 5, 6, 7.
signature_audit.impact_on_prior_runs: unified3 attribute scenario: 0 hits before. Refactor v2 targets steps 5-7 routed here. Existing scenarios (survey_setup, 3d_visualization): none of the added quoted phrases ('Energy', 'attribute overlay', 'bright-spot', 'Select Layer 2', 'attribute rendered') appear in those scenarios' visual_states, so no leakage. '3D Scene' as dialog is broad but numerator will be near 0 for non-attribute scenarios (only dialog matches, no keywords).
